text: I never said never, I just did it and that's that I always push forward and never look back I take what I want and make it happen Drawing the rapid, this is real, I'm not acting I'm bedding the grind, doing my time Busting my ass, going for mine Painting my pictures, writing my rhymes Losing my mind, trying to find my voice And now I'm here and I'm one of a kind I'll be that little guy that said we'd never reach the top From that little town where we ain't afraid of bus shots But little did they know that we can't be stopped That's why I took the little I had and made a lot
